definitions.explanation: The process of demolishing and rebuilding existing structures in an area, typically to modernize or revitalize an urban district. A major topic in Japanese urban planning.

examples.japanese: ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{再開発|さいかいはつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{始|はじ}まった→始まる：00841_hajimaru⟧。
examples.english: Redevelopment in front of the station has begun.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地区|ちく}→地区：03463_chiku⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{再開発|さいかいはつ}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わった→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧。
examples.english: This district changed dramatically through redevelopment.

examples.japanese: {再開発|さいかいはつ}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧⟦に{対|たい}して→に対して：06800_nitaishite⟧⟦{住民|じゅうみん}→住民：03281_juumin⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{反対|はんたい}→反対：01497_hantai⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{声|こえ}→声：02207_koe⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がっている→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
examples.english: Residents are raising voices of opposition to the redevelopment plan.

notes:
{再開発|さいかいはつ} refers to the demolition and rebuilding of existing structures in an area, typically to modernize or revitalize an urban district.

FORMS:
⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ (re-) + ⟦{開発|かいはつ}→開発：06746_kaihatsu⟧ (development). The prefix ⟦{再|さい}→再〜：03953_sai⟧ indicates doing something again.

USAGE:
Very common in news about urban planning. Major redevelopment projects in Tokyo (⟦{渋谷|しぶや}→渋谷：30632_shibuya⟧, ⟦{品川|しながわ}→品川：30707_shinagawa⟧, {虎ノ門|とらのもん}, etc.) are frequently discussed in the media. Often involves controversy over displacement of residents and small businesses.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {再開発|さいかいはつ}⟦{計画|けいかく}→計画：01172_keikaku⟧: redevelopment plan
- {再開発|さいかいはつ}⟦{事業|じぎょう}→事業：11421_jigyou⟧: redevelopment project
- {再開発|さいかいはつ}⟦エリア→エリア：10726_eria⟧: redevelopment area
- ⟦{駅前|えきまえ}→駅前：09593_ekimae⟧{再開発|さいかいはつ}: station-area redevelopment
- ⟦{市街地|しがいち}→市街地：17083_shigaichi⟧{再開発|さいかいはつ}: urban district redevelopment
